overall_goal: Add mushroom stock to the rice and simmer while stirring.

goals.description: Adjust the heat and pour the stock into the pan.
goals.rationale: The person turns down the hob, stirs the stock, and pours it into the frying pan.

goals.description: Stir the rice mixture as it simmers.
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to stir the rice and mushrooms, tapping it and shaking the pan to ensure even cooking and prevent burning.
